measurement.boundary: First source-frame identity quantization; final source-frame PTS plus its actual output presentation duration. Source interval coverage, video output duration, audio PCM tail and native duration are distinct records.
measurement.native: Chromium endpoint seeks confirm visible identities for MP4, MOV and WebM. A held last image at an audio-driven native duration does not prove a video endpoint.
measurement.cost: exportElapsedMs wraps the unchanged production runner; elapsedMs additionally includes source analysis and artifact metadata inspection. Both exclude native endpoint checks and independent ffmpeg analysis.
measurement.scope: Synthetic AVC/B-frame CFR and VFR inputs in Chromium 151 with Mediabunny1.65.2. WebM uses compatible VP8/Opus; other outputs AVC/AAC. No physical playback, universal codec or exact-boundary guarantee.
